string-array.name: fileHeader
string-array.item: "Awan TV settings: change the values, then send them to the TV:"
"Above each setting: what it is, its values and its default. Lines starting with // are notes, not read."
"A setting left out of the file stays as it is on the TV. The whole file is checked: one mistake stops the import and nothing changes."
"Before importing, the TV's settings are kept as a backup in state\\settings on the computer."

string-array.name: news_1_10_0
string-array.item: "The radio on your TVs from the computer"
"From the settings editor: see what each TV is playing now, and start or stop the radio on one TV or on all of them. A TV playing something else is not cut off unless you choose to."

string-array.name: news_1_13_0
string-array.item: "If Awan TV stops unexpectedly, a screen restarts it or opens the TV's own home. If it stops again, the TV runs on its own home for half an hour, so it stays usable."
"Put a TV right from the phone or the computer"
"Tick an up-to-date TV in the installer's My TVs or the editor's Update TVs, and it is set up again without sending the app anew."

string-array.name: news_1_14_0
string-array.item: "From the adhan until the iqamah, a small card in a corner over any app shows how long is left. Turn it off in Settings › Iqamah."
"A photo every ten minutes behind the times, only dark ones from Isha until Fajr. Turn them off in Settings › Display & language."

string-array.name: news_1_14_1
string-array.item: "Lapis by day and Charcoal after Maghrib, easier on the eyes at night. One colour all day in Settings › Display & language › Colours."

string-array.name: news_1_14_2
string-array.item: "After the app is removed and installed again, saved recitations come back with their reciters' and riwayahs' names, even without internet."

string-array.name: news_1_17_0
string-array.item: "El botón del globo junto a Ajustes abre la lista de idiomas, cada uno con su propio nombre. Tras elegir, la pantalla pregunta Mantener o Volver, y vuelve sola a los diez segundos sin respuesta."

string-array.name: news_1_18_0
string-array.item: "Todas las pantallas en urdu, con los recitadores y las suras con sus nombres en urdu. Elígelo con el botón del globo en inicio."
"En Ramadán la casilla de Fajr dice que empieza el ayuno. El imsak, una precaución opcional antes, se fija en Ajustes."

string-array.name: news_1_19_0
string-array.item: "Todas las pantallas en turco, con los términos de la Diyanet, y los recitadores y las suras con sus nombres en turco. Elígelo con el botón del globo en inicio."

string-array.name: news_1_20_0
string-array.item: "Todas las pantallas en francés, con los términos de las mezquitas francófonas, y los recitadores y las suras con sus nombres en francés. Elígelo con el botón del globo en inicio."

string-array.name: news_1_21_0
string-array.item: "Todas las pantallas en malayo, con los términos del JAKIM de Malasia. Elígelo con el botón del globo en inicio."

string-array.name: news_1_1_0
string-array.item: "Settings › Device settings › Remote buttons: make a button on any remote open what you choose."

string-array.name: news_1_2_0
string-array.item: "Settings › Prayer times › Adjust the times and the date: each time up to 30 minutes earlier or later, to match your masjid."
"When a newer version is out, About opens a window with a code to scan with a phone to reach its page."
"This window, once after each update, and in About."

string-array.name: news_1_3_0
string-array.item: "Oman's prayer times by its Ministry of Awqaf, chosen for its cities by themselves."
"Oman's Holy Quran Radio, and Saudi Arabia's Quran Radio and Nida Al-Islam, in Settings › Radio."
"It tells you of a newer installer, and says why it couldn't reach the TV and what to do."

string-array.name: news_1_4_0
string-array.item: "The radio card has a Station button: change the station or recitation without opening Settings."
"Each button you customised in Remote buttons can open something else when held."
"The adhan of Al-Masjid an-Nabawi, and Sheikh Ragheb Mustafa Ghalwash's, in Settings › Adhan."

string-array.name: news_1_5_0
string-array.item: "When a newer version is out, Home tells you with a code to scan with a phone, and a gold mark stays on the Settings button until you update."

string-array.name: news_1_7_0
string-array.item: "When a newer version is out, press Update now in its window: the app downloads it and installs it on the TV itself, with no phone or computer."

string-array.name: news_1_8_0
string-array.item: "Morocco's times as the ministry publishes them"
"The Moroccan Ministry of Habous' method, with the table of each of its 191 localities; pick the one near you in Settings › Prayer times › Ministry table."

string-array.name: news_1_9_0
string-array.item: "Recitations and the station from the computer"
"From the settings editor on Windows: choose recitations for one or more TVs to download by themselves, and change the station, without going to each TV."
